name: finchart-bench
description: A benchmark for interpreting financial charts and extracting/answering information from chart images and associated data. It evaluates a model's ability to read visual financializations (trends, values, annotations) and produce accurate textual or numeric answers. Typical tasks include visual question answering about chart features and extracting time-series insights.
reputation: A community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face aimed at financial-chart understanding; used by a small group of practitioners and researchers.
